summary: Skycorp Solar Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a share acquisition agreement to acquire the remaining 56% equity interest in Nanjing Cesun Power Co., Ltd. for approximately US$20.2 million, satisfied by issuing 3,079,000 Class A and 4,904,000 Class B ordinary shares. The transaction was approved by the board and audit committee as a related-party transaction. Concurrently, the company entered into securities purchase agreements for a $3.0 million PIPE at ~$1.77 per Class A share. Post-closing, 12,215,025 ordinary shares will be outstanding. Closing is subject to customary conditions; Class A shares have a six-month lock-up, Class B shares a 24-month lock-up. Watch for regulatory approval and shareholder reaction to overhang.
